#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
export GH_CONFIG_DIR=~/.config/gh-other

# args: tag:npmName:version ...
publish_batch() {
  local pairs=("$@")
  local tags=()
  local names=()
  local versions=()
  local pair tag name version
  for pair in "${pairs[@]}"; do
    tag="${pair%%:*}"
    rest="${pair#*:}"
    name="${rest%%:*}"
    version="${rest#*:}"
    tags+=("$tag")
    names+=("$name")
    versions+=("$version")
    if git rev-parse "$tag" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      echo "local tag exists $tag"
    else
      git tag "$tag" "$COMMIT"
    fi
  done
  git push origin "${tags[@]}"
  echo "pushed ${tags[*]}"

  local ids=()
  for tag in "${tags[@]}"; do
    local id=""
    for _ in $(seq 1 36); do
      id=$(gh run list --workflow "Publish tagged package" --limit 40 --json databaseId,headBranch --jq ".[] | select(.headBranch==\"$tag\") | .databaseId" | head -1)
      if [[ -n "$id" ]]; then
        break
      fi
      sleep 5
    done
    if [[ -z "$id" ]]; then
      echo "NO WORKFLOW for $tag" >&2
      return 1
    fi
    ids+=("$id")
    echo "run $tag -> $id"
  done

  local pid pids=()
  for id in "${ids[@]}"; do
    gh run watch "$id" --exit-status &
    pids+=("$!")
  done
  for pid in "${pids[@]}"; do
    wait "$pid"
  done

  local i latest githead
  for i in "${!names[@]}"; do
    name="${names[$i]}"
    version="${versions[$i]}"
    echo "verifying $name@$version"
    local ok=0
    for _ in $(seq 1 36); do
      if npm view "$name@$version" version >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        ok=1
        break
      fi
      sleep 5
    done
    if [[ "$ok" -ne 1 ]]; then
      echo "npm missing $name@$version" >&2
      return 1
    fi
    latest=$(npm view "$name" dist-tags.latest)
    githead=$(npm view "$name@$version" gitHead)
    echo "$name@$version latest=$latest gitHead=$githead"
    if [[ "$latest" != "$version" ]]; then
      echo "latest dist-tag mismatch for $name: $latest != $version" >&2
      return 1
    fi
    if [[ "$githead" != "$COMMIT" && "$githead" != "${COMMIT:0:7}" && "$githead" != "${COMMIT:0:9}" ]]; then
      echo "gitHead mismatch for $name@$version: $githead != $COMMIT" >&2
      return 1
    fi
  done
}
